description: Multiple EVA postponements occurred due to rain, fog, and near-freezing temperatures. On the worst day, constant rain at near-zero temperatures left no visibility for a suited EVA.
response: Crew redirected to indoor engineering and organisation work: ATV repair, food inventory, mold cleaning, plumbing, and leveling measurements.
lesson: Every mission day needs a 'rainy day task list' ready. The XO should prepare this before departure — a full day of high-value indoor work that can absorb any cancelled EVA.
pattern_tag: EVA weather cancellation / indoor contingency planning
